description: Opens Fiveable's interactive multiple-choice practice panel with existing question, answer and explanation components. Students select answers directly in the panel. Connected accounts can save answers to Fiveable progress; anonymous practice is an unsaved preview.

courseVariant.description: AP Calculus only (subject ap-calc): 'ab' hides BC-only units and topics; 'bc' includes them. Defaults to the student's saved Fiveable course when they are connected.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.
